verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so a cross-merchant, agent-facing product catalog or feed is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities: a per-store runtime schema call, CSV product import/export, and a headless API. None of these is a documented cross-merchant catalog or feed that makes products discoverable to AI agents or answer engines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my products are discoverable by AI agents and answer engines through a cross-merchant catalog or feed built for agents
